enabled.title: Enable user profile
enabled.description: Turn the automatic user profile system on or off

inject_profile.title: Inject user profile
inject_profile.description: Adds the confirmed user profile to the system prompt before each LLM request

idle_time.title: Idle trigger time (ms)
idle_time.description: How long to wait after a chat before analyzing the profile in the background. Default 3 minutes

update_on_exit.title: Try to update on exit
update_on_exit.description: When the plugin stops with unanalyzed chats, it tries one profile analysis

min_new_messages.title: Min new messages
min_new_messages.description: How many new messages since the last analysis before a new one runs

max_context_messages.title: Max context messages
max_context_messages.description: The most recent chat messages used per analysis

max_items_per_field.title: Max items per field
max_items_per_field.description: The most entries kept in each profile list, to keep the injected text small

profile_file.title: Profile file
profile_file.description: Path of the confirmed profile JSON file, relative to the live-2d folder

candidate_file.title: Candidate file
candidate_file.description: Path of the candidate observations JSON file, relative to the live-2d folder. Candidates are not added to prompts

profile_llm.title: Profile model
profile_llm.description: Separate model for profile diagnosis, candidate extraction and promotion. Leave empty to use the main chat model

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: API key of the profile model

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API address, for example https://api.deepseek.com

max_tokens.title: Max output tokens
max_tokens.description: Output token limit for profile analysis

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for one request to the profile model

profile_llm_fallback.title: Profile fallback model
profile_llm_fallback.description: Model used when the profile model fails

enabled.title: Enable fallback model
enabled.description: Switch to the fallback model when the profile model fails

api_key.title: Fallback API Key
api_key.description: API key of the fallback model

base_url.title: Fallback Base URL
base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API address of the fallback model

bootstrap_on_first_run.title: Diagnose from MemOS on first run
bootstrap_on_first_run.description: On the first start, builds a starting profile from the long-term memories already in MemOS

memos_api_url.title: MemOS API URL
memos_api_url.description: MemOS backend address for the first diagnosis and for confirming evidence

bootstrap_max_memories.title: First diagnosis memory limit
bootstrap_max_memories.description: How many long-term signals from MemOS go to the profile model

promote_count.title: Behavior promotion count
promote_count.description: On how many different days a habit/style candidate must appear before it is promoted

promote_span_days.title: Behavior promotion span (days)
promote_span_days.description: How many days must pass between the first and latest sighting of a habit/style candidate before it is promoted

candidate_ttl_days.title: Candidate expiry (days)
candidate_ttl_days.description: Candidates not seen again for this long after last_seen are archived

profile_stale_days.title: Profile expiry (days)
profile_stale_days.description: Profile items not seen for this long are moved back to candidates

recurrence_source.title: Evidence source
recurrence_source.description: local = local candidate pool only. memos = uses MemOS. hybrid = mainly local, with MemOS as confirmation

max_candidates.title: Max candidates
max_candidates.description: Limits the size of the candidate pool. Beyond it, the most recent and useful candidates are kept.

max_archived_candidates.title: Max archived candidates
max_archived_candidates.description: Limits the size of the candidate archive, so the file does not grow forever.
